story.title: A packaging specialist that knows the machines
story.p1: Harmac is a packaging-machine specialist based in Vantaa, in the Tikkurilan Simonkylä area. The starting point is simple: buying a packaging machine shouldn't be guesswork.
story.p2: Harmac imports packaging machines from leading European manufacturers and puts them into production: from small artisan bakeries to large food factories.
story.p3: Harmac doesn't sell whatever is easiest. Your production needs come first, then a recommendation that will still serve you years from now.
